text:
Maya R.: heads-up — noticed a sudden jump in hallucination/factual-error rate on the AWQ-int8 variant after we enabled cross-batch grouping=64 on canary. small sample: a news-summary prompt that was fine now invents dates.

Liam K.: link to the run? run id + logs pls

Maya R.: canary run: https://internal-runs/awq/1977 — logs attached. eval-bot summary below shows rouge drop ~3.2 points and factual-error up by ~7%.

eval-bot: METRICS: {"run":"1977","model":"gpt-open-awq-int8","group_size":"64","act_quant":"on","rouge":"-3.2","factual_err":"+7.1","ppl":"+0.9"} :bar_chart:

Anika S.: interesting. we've seen act-quant + large group sizes amplify small numeric perturbations during KV streaming. hypothesis: cross-batch grouping is reusing cached KV lengths that change attention alignment, and act quantization nonlinearly alters activations so softmax mass shifts.

RJ: checked runtime logs around step 2400. there are repeated small fp->int rescale warnings from awq_runtime: 
```
[awq_runtime] WARN rescale_overflow: scale_factor clipped at 1.23e+4, dropping tail precision
[awq_runtime] DEBUG kv_cache_write len=6144 prev_len=6096 align_check_fail=true
```
Maya R.: pasted two failing sample generations (truncated):
```
input: "Summarize: New vaccine trial begins in June 2025..."
gold: "Trial begins June 2025 in Seattle"
awq-64-act:on: "Trial begins February 2019 in Boston"  <-- hallucinated date + city
awq-8-act:off: "Trial begins June 2025 in Seattle"  <-- correct
```

Liam K.: can you repro locally with same seed? also how deterministic is the canary traffic mix?

Maya R.: yes repro with seed=42 on staging GPU-3 using the same traffic generator. i ran two quick variants: group_size=8 act_quant=off (baseline) and group_size=64 act_quant=on (canary). artifacts: https://artifacts/awq/1977/compare.tar.gz

Anika S.: thanks. plan: 1) run a microbenchmark that pins KV cache alignment and toggles act quant scale clamping to see which releases the failure, 2) try soft clamp on scale (reduce max_scale by 10x) and rerun group=64,3) if reproduces, roll back canary and open a runtime patch.

RJ: also observed a small increase in sample variance on logits (std of top-1 probs across seeds). attaching quick gist results: top1_std went 0.012 -> 0.045 for group 64 + act:on. could be numerical amplification.

deploy-bot: canary deployment 1977 -> gpt-open-awq-int8 at us-west-2/gpu-pool applied by @maya at 2026-10-04T09:12:33Z :rocket:

Maya R.: did quick canary rollback to group=16 at 09:20 — metrics already trending back towards baseline but we should not ship this to prod.

Liam K.: next steps from my side: run controlled sweep over group_size in [4,8,16,32,64] with act_quant toggled, collect rouge/factual error + top1_std. i'll spin up 8 concurrent workers. ETA ~2 hrs.

Anika S.: i'll instrument runtime to log "align_check_fail" with context (kv index, seq pos) and add opt-in flag to disable aggressive reusing of KV pointer offsets. small patch ready:
```
# runtime patch (pseudo)
if align_check_fail and act_quant_enabled:
    fallback_to_strict_alignment()
```

RJ: also propose adding a tiny jitter to rescale (uniform +-1e-6) to break exact pathological alignments for now. cheap mitigation until we understand root cause.

Maya R.: ran Liam's sweep quick pass: group=32 act:on shows mild degradation (-0.9 rouge, factual +2.5%), group=16 act:on ~neutral, group=8 act:on ~neutral, group=64 act:on worst. act:off variants are stable across group sizes. raw numbers in artifact.

Liam K.: thanks — that strongly suggests nonlinearity from act quant + large group aggregation. will baseline a canary with group=16 + act:on + jittered rescale and present stats in 2-3 runs.

Anika S.: opened issue AWQ-1254 with repro steps, logs, and candidate runtime patch. assigning @RJ for short mitigation and @Maya for canary monitoring.

RJ: i'll cut a canary runtime build with strict_alignment fallback + rescale jitter and post build id here once uploaded.

Maya R.: thx. keeping an eye on user-facing evals. if we see recurrence after the runtime fix we'll freeze act_quant on AWQ-int8 until we complete deeper numerical analysis.

eval-bot: NEW_COMPARE: run1977 vs run1977-fix1: preliminary rouge delta +1.1, factual_err -3.8 after strict_alignment + jitter. CI still running.

Liam K.: tl;dr: don't enable cross-batch grouping >32 with act-quant enabled until we validate alignment/rescale protections. add this to onboarding checklist for AWQ models.

Maya R.: filing a short blurb for release notes / rollback rationale. will ping infra to add a guard in canary pipeline to prevent group_size>32 with act_quant:true unless opt-in flag set. :white_check_mark:

Anika S.: great. follow-up: schedule deep dive next Tues. invite @eng-ml, @eng-runtime, and @eng-ml-evals.

RJ: build uploaded: awq-runtime-v2.10-canary-1977. run id run1977-fix1 created. monitoring now.

Maya R.: thanks team. closing thread once CI finishes and we confirm stability. :wave:
